High-resolution (600 dpi) scan of the printed Decipher card [[Corporal Prescott]] (Special Edition, Dark Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Special Edition/SE Dark/Corporal Prescott.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/0B8qrn2aDKgPeVFd3N3hlS190bTQ/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Corporal Prescott.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,339,096 bytes, SHA-256 <code>bb17d1b1486cedee007019e9e9ddd8bce06b943841ef8cc96b3c015de1121227</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the scan, 44.5, 47.5, 72.5, 57.0 px); resized: no; no other change.
